description: Renovate keeps dependencies current for this Claude Code plugin repo. A plugin repo is mostly templates + markdown, so the main moving surface is GitHub Action pins (in .github/workflows/*.yml and, when the repo ships bootstrap templates, in *.tmpl). Renovate replaces Dependabot here (templates aren't production dependency manifests).

customManagers.description: Extract GitHub Action `uses:` pins from *.tmpl files. The stock github-actions manager only scans .yml/.yaml, so action pins baked into templates a plugin repo ships are otherwise invisible to drift detection. Harmless when the repo has no templates.

packageRules.description: Batch every GitHub Action upgrade (both .yml and .tmpl) into one weekly PR for a single review + merge.
